identity.individuality_rule: Two Solen of the same species are not required to share personality, temperament, affection style, social behavior, preferences, fears, habits, or reactions.

personality.behavior_rule: Personality rolls change how this individual Solen expresses an intent. They do not change the underlying biological need.

preference_discovery.discovery_rule: Repeated experiences gradually establish the individual Solen's preferences rather than assigning universal species favorites.

care_willingness.rule: High bond can increase trust and willingness, but does not force an individual Solen to become cheerful, social, affectionate, energetic, or obedient.

progression.base_stats_reference: Preserve existing egg.base_stats; live starter-species.ts remains authoritative. No stats or XP reconciliation performed.

xp_schedule.interpretation: xp_to_reach_level is the additional XP required since previous level; cumulative_xp_to_reach_level is total lifetime XP needed

xp_schedule.invariant: Do not treat null XP as zero, and do not award levels from this proposal until implemented and validated

player_skill_decisions.replacement_semantics: Future approved milestones only: preserve existing animation timing; show four eligible skill names/descriptions, never role labels; select and confirm one. Validate ownership, eligibility and retry identity to prevent duplicate learning/rewards. Replacement must respect authoritative learned capacity, explicitly confirm the old skill and commit atomically. Four local equipped slots do not establish learned capacity. Cancel/failure preserves old skills; unselected skills are not learned. No UI or persistence activated.
